name: postText
label: Post Text
help: Post content, must be up to 3000 characters. Write @[key] where a mention should appear.

name: mentions
label: Mentions
help: People and companies to mention in the text. Each item binds a @[key] placeholder to one entity.

spec.name: key
spec.label: Key
spec.help: Placeholder name used in the text as @[key]. From 1 to 30 characters: letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.

spec.name: name
spec.label: Name
spec.help: Name to find the person or company by. Always required, because LinkedIn resolves a mention through its own name suggestions.

spec.name: urn
spec.label: URN
spec.help: URN of the person or company, deciding which of the offered namesakes is taken. Provide at most one identifier.

spec.name: personHashedUrl
spec.label: Person Hashed URL
spec.help: Hashed LinkedIn profile URL, as an alternative to the URN

spec.name: companyHashedUrl
spec.label: Company Hashed URL
spec.help: Hashed LinkedIn company page URL, as an alternative to the URN

name: companyUrl
label: Company URL
help: LinkedIn company page URL. If specified, the post will be created on the company page (requires admin access).

name: attachments
label: Attachments
help: Media attachments for the post (max 9 images, or 1 video, or 1 document). Cannot mix different attachment types.

spec.name: url
spec.label: File URL
spec.help: Publicly accessible URL of the media file

spec.name: name
spec.label: Document Name
spec.help: Display name for the document (required for documents)
